recognize_zh: CD30 染色整片幾乎無棕色著色，散在的大型細胞（核大、淡染、呈多葉或空泡狀，如左中與下方）在小淋巴球背景中完全陰性；大細胞 CD30 陰性是 NLPHL 的 LP 細胞與典型 RS 細胞（CD30 強陽性）的重要區別。
features: Immunohistochemical stain for CD30 at high power
Scattered large cells with vesicular, lobulated or folded nuclei are CD30-negative
No membranous or Golgi-pattern staining in any large cell; only rare faint nonspecific brown specks
Lymphocyte-rich background without sheets of large cells
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD30 is essentially negative. The scattered large cells with vesicular, lobulated nuclei show no membranous or Golgi-type staining, and the background small lymphocytes are also negative; only rare faint nonspecific specks are present. The absence of CD30 in the large cells argues against Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells of classic Hodgkin lymphoma. Findings support LP cells and are consistent with nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; an internal positive control (occasional activated immunoblasts) should be confirmed on the slide.

ddx.vs: HRS cells show strong membranous and paranuclear dot CD30 staining in nearly all cases, whereas the large cells here are CD30-negative.
ALCL shows strong, uniform CD30 in sheets or sinusoidal clusters of large cells, not seen here.
Large cells are likewise CD30-negative, so it must be separated by diffuse architecture with few small B cells and loss of follicular dendritic meshworks.
